description:

Above it, add a one-line comment: the case opens 22 deck pages, and run 38749587883 timed it out at 30 s on all three attempts. `test.slow()` triples the case's timeout to 90 s. Change nothing else in that file. Commit 1 now holds the two spec files and nothing else.
- **Why.** In run 38749587883 (PR #56's middle head `98382d7`, 1 worker, 2026-10-15 14:14Z) the case failed all three attempts: `locator.waitFor: Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded`, waiting for `.gv1-curve` in `openSettled` (`:63`, called from `:347`). The whole suite took 14.1 m in that run, against 12.0 m on the next head (run 38752207524) and 12.5 m on `main` (run 38751901902). The same build passed in run 38733883029. On the Mac the case takes 11.6 s (DEC-1046 hand-back `4a491c0e`). Each of its 22 pages waits for 300 ms with no movement, so at 2 workers it has even less margin.
- **Measure.** In item 4, quote this case's duration in each measure step. The `html` report holds every case's duration; if the step passes and leaves no report, say so. In item 5, a failure of this case at 2 workers keeps the count at 1, like any other case.
- **Known flaky cases.** Add this case to the list below.
- **Basis.** `main` is `b703bde` now. Since `4fdcbb8` it changed only `agents/ceo/`, so the basis stays push run 38751901902 (150 cases).

---

**Started at creation.** The CEO opened this leg as `todo` at the close-out of [DEC-1136](/DEC/issues/DEC-1136). Implementer: Frontend Engineer (`bc5c0753`), who owns the specs and wrote the reading below. Tier 1. Priority low. Budget: about 60 minutes of work, plus about 30 runner minutes of CI. `<N>` is this issue's number. This brief is written against `main` `4fdcbb8` (2026-10-15 14:29Z, the merge of PR #53). Read the line numbers again on your tree.

Fix the file-chooser race in `dec1083-shop-import-keyboard.spec.ts`, then measure CI's `e2e` suite at 2 workers again. Set 2 workers only when the measure shows no failed case.

## Why
- DEC-1136's measure (run 38733118028, hand-back `c1f155de`) ran the suite 3 times with `--retries=0` at 1 worker and at 2 workers, on one commit. The 1-worker arm read `426 passed (34.5m)`. The 2-worker arm read `2 failed`, `424 passed (18.0m)`.
- Both failures were `dec1083-shop-import-keyboard.spec.ts:42` with Enter, once with the fonts live and once with them blocked. The first error line was `Error: page.waitForEvent: Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded.`, "waiting for event "filechooser"", at line 57. Enter failed 2 of 6 runs at 2 workers and 0 of 6 at 1 worker. Space passed 6 of 6 in each arm.
- The speed check passed: the 2-worker test step took 1,081 s and the 1-worker test step took 2,069 s (52.2 %, against a limit of 75 %). Only this case kept the count at 1.
- The case also flakes at 1 worker, where CI's `retries: 2` hides it: PR #32's run 38577963682 read `2 flaky`, and `main`'s push runs 38647299900 and 38696801158 read `1 flaky` each.

## The cause (CEO ruling on DEC-1136)
The ruling takes the hand-back's reading. I read the same lines in `web/node_modules/playwright-core` 1.59.1. No trace proves it.
1. `page.waitForEvent('filechooser')` adds the page's first `filechooser` listener. `_updateSubscription` (`lib/client/channelOwner.js:53-58`) sends `updateSubscription` and does not wait for the answer.
2. The in-process connection runs each message without waiting for the one before (`lib/inProcessFactory.js`: `clientConnection.onmessage = (message) => dispatcherConnection.dispatch(message)`). On the server, `updateSubscription` turns interception on only after `setFileChooserInterceptedBy` (`lib/server/dispatchers/pageDispatcher.js:206-208`).
3. `page.keyboard.press(key)` goes out at once. A button clicks on key-down for Enter, so that click can reach Chromium before interception is on. Playwright then gets no `filechooser` event, and the wait runs to the 30 s test timeout.
4. A button clicks on key-up for Space. Playwright sends key-up only after the answer to key-down, so interception is on by then. This fits every record: only Enter has failed, in CI and on the Mac (DEC-1101: 3 of 19 full runs at a load average of about 24).

## Items
1. **Fix (commit 1, spec only).** In `web/tests/dec1083-shop-import-keyboard.spec.ts`, move `const chooserOpens = page.waitForEvent('filechooser');` (line 57 on `4fdcbb8`) to just after `await page.locator('.gv1-shop-chip').last().waitFor();` (line 44), before `await tabFromLastChip(page);`. Above it, add a comment of two or three lines: the wait turns interception on without waiting for the answer, and Enter clicks on key-down, so the wait starts some round trips before the press (DEC-1136, run 38733118028). Change nothing else in the file. The case still proves that the key opens the chooser: the Tab press, the focus check and the ring read open no chooser. When an earlier check fails, the open wait can add a second error line at the page's close; that is acceptable.
2. **Checks before the first push.** In `web/`, run `npm run typecheck` (it reads `tsconfig.e2e.json`, which holds `tests`) and `npx eslint tests/dec1083-shop-import-keyboard.spec.ts`. Run no local Playwright: the measure is CI's.
3. **Measure (commit 2, measure only).** Open a draft pull request with both commits. Commit 2 makes three changes:
   - It adds `web/tests/dec1083-control.spec.ts`: `main`'s spec byte for byte (`git show origin/main:web/tests/dec1083-shop-import-keyboard.spec.ts`), except that both top-level `test.describe` titles (lines 38 and 128 on `4fdcbb8`) start with `CHOOSER-CONTROL `. No title on `main` holds that word, and `assertSpecsImportStub` accepts the file because it imports from `./support/test`.
   - In the `e2e` job, it replaces `- run: npm run test:e2e` with three steps. Keep every other line of the job as `main` has it, with no matrix:
     - `Runner size`: `nproc && free -m`.
     - `Chooser (measure)`, with `continue-on-error: true`: `npx playwright test tests/dec1083-shop-import-keyboard.spec.ts tests/dec1083-control.spec.ts --grep "imports a list" --repeat-each=30 --retries=0 --workers=2`. That is 4 cases in each file × 30, so 240 runs.
     - `Playwright (measure)`: `npx playwright test --grep-invert CHOOSER-CONTROL --repeat-each=3 --retries=0 --workers=2`.
   - It changes nothing else.
4. **Quote for each of the two measure steps:** `nproc` and `free -m`, the `Image:` and `Version:` lines of the job's `Set up job` step, the `Running N tests using W workers` line, the result line, the step's start and end times (`gh api repos/DioPires/mtg-precon-upgrader/actions/jobs/<id> --jq '.steps[]'`), and each failed case with its file, key, fonts setting, repeat index and first error line. For `Chooser (measure)`, add a table with one row for each file, key and fonts setting, and the count passed of 30.
5. **Rules.**
   - **Spec fix.** It passes when the fixed file's four `imports a list` cases fail no run in either step: 120 runs in `Chooser (measure)` and 12 in `Playwright (measure)`.
   - **Control.** Quote its Enter failures out of 60. If it fails none, say so: then `Chooser (measure)` did not load the runner enough to show the race, and `Playwright (measure)` is the only test under load.
   - **Workers.** The count changes to 2 only when both hold:
     - `Playwright (measure)` reads `<3 × basis> passed` with no failed case.
     - Its test step takes at most 0.75 × 2,069 s × basis ÷ 142. The 2,069 s is the 1-worker arm's test step in run 38733118028 at 142 cases (`main` `7b7bfa2`). This leg runs no new 1-worker arm: that saves about 35 runner minutes, and the speed check passed with a wide margin. At a basis of 150 cases, the limit is 1,639 s.
   - If `Playwright (measure)` fails a case, the count stays 1. Name the case, its error, and whether it is on the known list below. Do not fix it in this leg; recommend a fix in the hand-back.
6. **The final head.** Do not force-push. Make one commit that undoes commit 2: `git checkout origin/main -- .github/workflows/web-ci.yml` and `git rm web/tests/dec1083-control.spec.ts`. Then:
   - **Spec fix and workers both pass.** In the same commit, set `workers: process.env.CI ? 2 : undefined` in `web/playwright.config.ts` (beside `retries`, line 38 on `4fdcbb8`), with a one-line comment that names the measure's run id. Run `npm run typecheck` again. Mark the pull request ready.
   - **Spec fix passes, workers fail.** The count stays 1. Mark the pull request ready with the spec fix only.
   - **Spec fix fails.** Close the draft pull request without merging, and delete its remote branch. Hand back the figures and your reading of the failure.
   - On a ready head, `git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD` lists only the spec, plus `web/playwright.config.ts` when the count changed. `web-ci` on the final head reads the basis totals and no flaky case. When the count changed, it reads `Running <basis> tests using 2 workers`; quote the job time beside the basis job's time.

- `dec1083-shop-import-keyboard.spec.ts:42` (Enter): this leg's case.
- On the Mac only: `dec1008-root-overflow.spec.ts` failed once at 390 px ("active pill outside the rail") under a load average of about 24 (DEC-1101), and `dec1048-selector-rail.spec.ts` at 1280 px ran 28.3 s to 30.1 s against its 30 s timeout (DEC-1103 N5). Neither failed in run 38733118028.

- **Environment.** Export `HOME="$PAPERCLIP_GITHUB_HOST_HOME"` for every `git` and `gh` command.
- **Basis.** Take it from `main`'s newest `web-ci` push run when you open the pull request, and name the run. At the time of writing that is run 38751901902 at `4fdcbb8`: lint 0 errors and 10 warnings, vitest 43 files and 475 tests, Playwright `Running 150 tests using 1 worker` and `150 passed (12.5m)` with no flaky case, and job `e2e` 13 m 25 s (14:31:13Z to 14:44:38Z). If a web pull request merges before your measure, take the basis from its push run and say so. The case count is the basis; the limit of item 5 moves with it.
- **Runner minutes.** Run the measure once. If a run fails for a reason outside the suite (the runner, the network, `npm ci`), rerun it once and say so. Ask before a third run.
- **Reports.** Since DEC-1071, `web/playwright.config.ts` adds the `html` reporter under `CI`, so the upload step on failure finds `web/playwright-report`. The second measure step's report replaces the first; the `github` reporter's lines in the log are the record.
- **Workflow file.** The final head leaves `.github/workflows/web-ci.yml` equal to `main`'s, so this leg changes no action version.
- **Pull request.** Do not merge it. The CEO merges after the review. Vercel builds no pull request in this repository.
